mapper.insert: INSERT INTO room (hotel_id, room_type_id, room_number, floor, status) VALUES (#{hotelId}, #{roomTypeId}, #{roomNumber}, #{floor}, #{status})
mapper.update: UPDATE room SET hotel_id=#{hotelId}, room_type_id=#{roomTypeId}, room_number=#{roomNumber}, floor=#{floor}, status=#{status} WHERE id=#{id}
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM room WHERE hotel_id=#{hotelId} ORDER BY room_number LIMIT #{limit} OFFSET #{offset}
